anchor_provenance: Observed research worktree CreationTimeUtc, rounded to seconds; human message receipt and pre-worktree activity were not measured.

scope.observed_span: Includes setup, historical/source/resource review, failed preparation, Native0 regressions, both execution epochs, pause/recovery and post-run independent validation up to recorded_UTC. Report rendering and Git delivery occur later and are separately timestamped.
scope.execution_epochs: Both execution epochs, shared Native0, source-epoch recovery and independent validation; report/audit wall is added separately in final study timing.
scope.method_wall: Measured algorithm entry through all restricted calls and independent candidate FULL Replay; each method starts its own original U4 point.
scope.pre_Optimize_build: Worker entry through model load/construction/readback/Native0/admission; not a pure model assembly benchmark.
scope.component_accounting: Component times are measured subscopes, not quantities to add to algorithm or execution wall. Overlapping or concurrent independent preparation is not assigned invented exclusive durations.
scope.unmeasured: No exact human receipt timestamp, no exclusive initial setup/history phase durations; no zero-time claim for these activities.
scope.report_end: REPORT_RENDER_RECEIPT.json separately records observed worktree-to-report time including report construction.
